description: The National Bank of Ukraine's official numbers in one call: official hryvnia (UAH) exchange rates for 40+ currencies and gold, silver, platinum and palladium, with 1-day and 1-week change; the key policy rate with the overnight loan and deposit-certificate rates and its last change; and official reserve assets (USD) with the month's change. Pick up to 10 currencies or all. Data: NBU open data API. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

currency.description: Comma-separated codes, up to 10 (default USD,EUR,PLN,GBP,CNY), or all
